description: Puts one of the questions CodeGene asked the person (whats_waiting lists them under `notices`) to THEM: in a prompt your client shows them, one option per choice, when it can; otherwise the answer gives the question and the CodeGene Inbox link where they answer it. You never pick the answer: an answer such as yes to a new design can start work on their site, so only the person gives it. Their pick is the same answer as one in the Inbox or a reply to the email. If a prompt you expected never appeared, do not ask again: send finish_with "link" and give them the link.

finish_with.description: Leave out. "link" skips the prompt and returns the CodeGene Inbox link to send the person, for an assistant that cannot show prompts from a tool.

notice_id.description: The question (whats_waiting lists them under notices).

workspace_id.description: The workspace (whoami lists them). May be left out when the connection has only one.

name: answer_notice
title: Put a question CodeGene asked to the person
